### Loved to the End
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/loved-to-the-end
Passage: John 13:1
Points:
- The Passover setting highlights Jesus as the ultimate sacrificial Lamb who redeems His people.
- Jesus remained entirely sovereign over His impending death, submitting voluntarily to the divine plan.
- Loving His own to the end means loving them to the close of life and to the utmost possible degree.
- The cross provides undeniable, ongoing assurance of Christ's steadfast love for believers.

### The Most High on His Knees
Author: Greg Morse
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-most-high-on-his-knees
Passage: John 13:3-5
Points:
- Jesus' act of washing dirty feet stemmed from deep inner confidence in His identity and destination.
- Knowing the Father had placed all things in His hands, Jesus served from divine wealth rather than deficit.
- Fixing His heart on returning to the Father empowered Jesus to embrace humble service and endure the cross.
- Believers who grasp their secure heavenly inheritance are freed to embrace the lowliest acts of love.

### Proud Hearts and Dirty Feet
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-june-7-2023.html
Passage: John 13:3-11
Points:
- Walking the dusty and muddy streets of Jerusalem made foot-washing an indispensable courtesy for dinner guests.
- In the absence of a servant, guests were expected to volunteer graciously to serve one another.
- None of the disciples offered to serve because they were preoccupied with pride and personal status.
- The disciples were eager to compete for a throne but unwilling to take up a towel.
- Jesus exposed their pride by stepping down into the role of a household slave.

### The Hour for Which Jesus Came
Author: Michael A. Youssef
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-april-2-2026.html
Passage: John 13:1
Points:
- The cross stood at the center of Jesus' mission throughout every stage of His earthly life.
- Earlier in His ministry, Jesus refrained from public ambition because His appointed hour had not arrived.
- Gathering for the Last Supper, Jesus washed His disciples' feet knowing His hour to depart had finally come.
- Jesus willingly embraced the cross in joyful obedience to the Father to rescue sinners.
